**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

The Agreement imposes no most-favoured-nation obligation on Tri City National Bank. Pricing is set exclusively by the Fee Schedule (§8.1), with adjustments limited to volume-based resource units (§8.1(ii)) and good-faith renegotiation if pre-Conversion pricing assumptions prove inaccurate (§8.3) — no obligation to extend M&I terms given to other providers, disclose third-party pricing, or match competing offers. §3 (Appointment) likewise contains no comparable-terms mechanic.

The absence of an MFN in our favour is a nice-to-have under this rule only, so no redline was proposed.
